weakness: No MFA on the SYS-01 administrator account or the camera account
remediation_plan: Create the named fill-in account first (POAM-002), then turn on MFA for SYS-01 and the camera app; recovery codes to the sealed envelope
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on and tested from a new browser

weakness: One shared SYS-01 administrator account; stale session on the fill-in technician's phone; no account review; shared password never changed
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives); P03 G-053, G-057
remediation_plan: End the stale session (done 2026-07-27); new password; named fill-in account without export or settings rights, disabled between cover periods; quarterly user and session review
milestones: 2026-07-27 stale session ended; 2026-09-30 named account in use and first quarterly review logged
resources_required: Owner time; possible extra user fee (about $20 a month for cover months only)

weakness: Passcodes, account passwords, and card numbers in ticket notes; customer data copies and printed day lists kept with no retention rule
source: P07 assessment (SI-12 objectives); P03 G-037, G-038, G-110, G-117
remediation_plan: Restricted passcode field cleared at release; stop collecting account passwords; purge historical notes and the 4 card numbers; 14-day deletion rule for copies; shred old day lists; monthly note search
milestones: 2026-09-15 card numbers purged; 2026-10-31 notes purged and backlog deleted with a log
resources_required: Owner time (about 12 hours over several Mondays)

weakness: Bench PC and two transfer drives unencrypted with about 1.6 TB of customer data
remediation_plan: Bench PC password now; built-in full-disk encryption; replace the two drives with hardware-encrypted drives; keys in the password manager
milestones: 2026-09-15 password and lock; 2026-10-31 encryption verified and old drives sanitized

weakness: Two people share one SYS-01 identity, so the log cannot tell who acted
remediation_plan: Closed by the named fill-in account in POAM-002

weakness: No sanitization procedure or per-device record; drop-off devices not reset; transfer drives reused without wiping
source: P07 assessment (MP-06 objectives); P03 G-038, G-108, G-115
remediation_plan: POL-01 8.6 and 8.7: SP 800-88 Rev. 2 method by device type, verification, per-device record; wipe the drop-off backlog; remove the website claim now
milestones: 2026-09-15 website claim removed; 2026-10-31 procedure and log in use for all drop-offs

weakness: Flat network: customer devices, customers' phones, shop devices, and the terminal share one Wi-Fi network
remediation_plan: Turn on the guest network for customers; separate bench network for customer devices; change the router password and update firmware; monthly check of connected devices
milestones: 2026-10-31 networks separated and ping test repeated

weakness: No vendor list or terms with the fill-in technician, recycler, or AI vendor
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P03 G-025, G-026
remediation_plan: Fill-in agreement with confidentiality terms (2026-09-30); AI training off and business terms or stop (P10, 2026-09-30); vendor list; recycler data addendum
milestones: 2026-09-30 fill-in agreement signed and AI decision applied; 2026-12-31 recycler addendum and vendor list
resources_required: Owner time; AI business plan if kept (about $25 a month)

weakness: No review or update cycle for the risk assessment
remediation_plan: POL-01 4.3 sets an annual July review and change triggers
